name: utility_project_web_screens
title: Utility Project Web Screens
description: Website screenshots of a project from src/content/img/projects/<media.path>/web/website/desktop/ and .../phone/. The "_0" image (web_desktop_0.webp, web_phone_0.webp, web_0.webp, web-m-0.webp ...) comes first, then natural order (web_1, web_2 ... web_10). first() is the cover used by device cards, previews and thumbnails; sort() is also used by project_media_gallery so the galleries show the same order.
